evidence_boundary: SW2-01 acceptance covers the immutable source snapshot, process-local reusable derived facts, dependency-aware governance DAG, governance-parity regressions, current static sequence evidence, and measured execution improvement relative to the accepted pre-V2/current-main contract. Runtime/E2E is not applicable to this repository-only governance-engine phase. Repository merge enforcement remains deferred to SW2-07; Mermaid renderability and bounded human diagram complexity remain deferred to SW2-03. SW2-02 execution-mode work is not part of this acceptance.
